attempts.query: PARDUS Uragano EVO ride review stiffness
attempts.note: Review describes a relatively stiff frame, strong out-of-saddle road response and noticeable coarse-gravel vibration unless tire pressure is reduced; qualitative evidence only.

notes: The qualitative evidence lives on the exact Uragano EVO record; no measured stiffness score is claimed.

resolution.note: The review describes firm ride tuning, but this is subjective and unmeasured and is not mapped to the community build. No historical search-channel attempts were rewritten.
